units.source_text: 可是，真要作出改变作战方案的决定，还需要时间，他好一阵子犹豫。

en.t: But to actually make the decision to change his plan of attack would still take time, and he hesitated for quite a while.

units.source_text: 女人出去“清沙”，已经过了四个小时了吧。

en.t: It must have been four hours already since the woman had gone out to clear away the sand.

units.source_text: 正是第二次搬运大网篮的男人们，结束预定的工作，准备返回三轮摩托车去的时候。

en.t: It was just when the men carrying the large basket for the second time had finished the scheduled work and were about to return to the three-wheeled motorcycle.

units.source_text: 他竖起耳朵，等听明白男人们不再回来后，偷偷起来穿好衣服。

en.t: He pricked up his ears, and after he was sure from the sounds that the men would not be coming back, he quietly got up and dressed.

units.source_text: 女人把灯拿走了，他只好摸索着到处找东西。

en.t: The woman had taken the lamp away, so he had no choice but to grope around searching for his things.

units.source_text: 鞋子里灌满了沙子直到鞋口。

en.t: His shoes were filled with sand all the way up to the openings.

units.source_text: 他把宽大的裤脚管塞到袜子里去，掏出绑腿带揣进了裤袋。

en.t: He tucked the wide legs of his trousers into his socks, took out the gaiter straps, and stuffed them into his trouser pocket.

units.source_text: 他把自己的采集工具，归拢到门边容易够得着的地方。

en.t: He gathered his collecting tools together in a place by the door where he could easily reach them.

units.source_text: 于是，下到了泥地间，幸好厚厚的沙子如同绒毯，他可以放心大胆地走，没有必要去顾虑脚步声。

en.t: Then he stepped down onto the earthen floor; fortunately, the thick sand was like a velvet carpet, so he could walk boldly without worrying about the sound of his footsteps.
